SV EN FR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

He is risen. What light, what joy! O death, where is thy victory? He is ascended to heaven’s height; All power and glory He possesses. He, who took upon Himself our sin and need, He, who on the cross for us became dead, He is risen, He lives!

2.

“He is risen, He is not here,” The message the angel brings. In glory He is exalted; May we on the wings of worship Praise-sing God, who to us the victory gave, When the stone was removed from Christ’s grave And He was raised to life.

3.

He is risen! That “grain of wheat,” Which was laid down into the earth, He bore much fruit unto His God And the first-fruit sheaf has come. No more “alone”! In eternity His joy, His power, and His glory With His redeemed He shares.

Text: Lina Sandell, 1882, bearb. 1916. Musik: Han är uppstånden av Fredrika Wickman, 1876. 9.8.9.8.9.9.8
